answer: The desk takes a 7-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. To join, a name must pass Colourbound wool dyer dye charter, which works because a charter wool dyers hold after dyehouse inspections. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Every vine is counted once. The dawn is checked, not assumed. One ledge, one entry.
